name: Sogeri Plateau
reason: Second-tier area stop named by Wikivoyage (Southern PNG) and the tourism board's Sogeri story: popular weekend trip with picnic sites, rapids, walks and fresh produce.
objection: It is an area, not one place, and overlaps Varirata and the rapids; its Wikipedia article is the town.

name: Varirata National Park
reason: National park, PNG's first, named by the tourism board with lookouts, lake, trails, bird watching; Wikivoyage Western PNG points to it as a Port Moresby base; admission K10.
objection: Only one counted source and no page views; mostly a local picnic destination.

name: Varirata Main Lookout
reason: Rule 3: a lookout inside a national park is part of the park; the only source is the same park story.
objection: The story calls it the park's most popular attraction, so a visitor may seek it by name.

name: Iarokrai Rapids
reason: One counted source (tourism board story): family-run campsite and rapids with a 2 hr trek to a stone-markings site; a half-day-plus visit but booking by phone, closed Saturdays.
objection: For: board names it as a 'best kept secret' with a swim and trek. Against: one source, small private operator, near-duplicate of Crystal Rapids/Sogeri area.

name: Crystal Rapids
reason: No counted source names it as a place to go; the board story mentions it only in passing as 'overly popular' while describing Iarokrai. Re-looked: nothing found.
objection: OSM waterfall node and a popular weekend swimming spot per the board.

name: Sirinumu Dam
reason: No counted source; the board story only mentions it as a landmark for directions; a reservoir with no verified visitor offering.
objection: Wikipedia has 1,000 views and notes kayaking and tilapia farm tours.

name: Koitaki
reason: No counted source; village with a country club, Wikipedia only; not a visitor stop (rule 1).
objection: Trekkers overnight there.

name: Owers' Corner
reason: Two counted sources (Wikivoyage Southern PNG, tourism board Bomana page): southern start of the Kokoda Track with the Kokoda Track Memorial and Owen Stanley views; Central-side stop, not duplicated in Oro.
objection: A memorial and trailhead; could be folded into the Kokoda Track entry, and the road is rough.

name: Efogi
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia-only village on the track (rule 1). Re-looked, none found.
objection: Named WWII battle site that trekkers pass.

name: Eora Creek
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia-only battle site (rule 1); it also lies in Oro Province, so any entry belongs to the Oro region.
objection: Well-known WWII site on the track.

name: APEC Haus
reason: Rule 2: a building seen from Ela Beach, public access unconfirmed; the board names it only as a photo landmark beside Ela Beach.
objection: One counted source calls it an iconic landmark with 'photo opportunities'.

name: Touaguba Hill
reason: Wikivoyage itself says 'not so much to see'; a residential hill with ambassadors' homes, view only (rule 3, minor viewpoint).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it with a nice view over the city and sea.

name: Moitaka Wildlife Sanctuary
reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage See): crocodiles and birds on the Sir Hubert Murray Highway; access, hours and condition unverified.
objection: For: a wildlife stop with a guide listing. Against: one thin line, no hours or site, possibly run down.

name: Atama Beach
reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage Do, free, open 24h) at Pari on Taurama Road; a beach with a hiking route is second-tier, but the listing is a single line.
objection: For: an open-access beach near Loloata. Against: single source, local use, safety concerns.

name: Taurama Aquatic and Indoor Centre
reason: A sports complex popular with locals; plain sports venue, not a visitor draw (rule 2/3).
objection: Listed under Wikivoyage Do as a swim spot.

name: Adventure Park PNG
reason: Two counted tourism-board pages (things-to-do, Port Moresby page) name this amusement park with lakes, gardens, aviaries and small zoo at 14 Mile; permanent venue.
objection: Family venue of unverified condition; no page views.

name: Gordons Market
reason: Daily market named by the tourism board as the city's largest fresh produce market (rule 4: daily market is fine); produce, crafts, bilums.
objection: One counted source, advice is to go with a guide; safety concerns.

name: Boroko Market
reason: One counted source (same board article) names it alongside Gordons Market as a daily market; a near-duplicate of Gordons in type.
objection: For: daily market, board-named. Against: single mention, safety, near-duplicate.

name: Ela Beach Craft Market
reason: Rule 4: held on the last Saturday of each month.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it under See.

name: Moresby Arts Theatre Craft Market
reason: Rule 4: monthly market.
objection: Named by the tourism board.

name: Hiri Moale Festival
reason: Rule 4: annual festival, an event, not a place.
objection: Two counted sources and a spectacular canoe race.

name: Hanuabada
reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage lists Hiri villages); a large stilt-house Motu village on the harbour, strong Wikipedia interest (6,288 views); visiting is cultural but needs a guide and has safety issues.
objection: For: the city's best-known cultural village. Against: a living community, no visitor facilities, one source.

name: Port Moresby Reef and Wreck Dive Sites
reason: A group of sites, not one place; Loloata Island is the place visitors go (COVERAGE: operator/tour is not a spot).
objection: Wikivoyage names diving as a Do item.

name: Loloata Island
reason: Two counted tourism-board pages: island 20-30 min by boat with snorkelling, diving, kayaks and day visits.
objection: A private resort; access via the resort only.

name: Motupore Island
reason: No counted source; a university research station, not open to visitors (rule 1, 2).
objection: Wikipedia lists it with coral reefs.

name: Bootless Inlet
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia only. Re-looked: the board and Wikivoyage name Loloata, not the inlet (rule 1).
objection: Real bay with islands and reef.

name: Redscar Bay
reason: No counted source; Wikipedia/Pacific Wrecks only (rule 1).
objection: WWII aircraft crash sites and a coral reef.

name: Hiritano Highway
reason: A road, a way of getting to Kerema, not a place (COVERAGE: spot is a place); a drive without a destination of its own.
objection: Two counted sources describe the 4 hour drive.

name: Lakekamu Basin
reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage Western PNG): remote 2,500 sq km rainforest in Gulf for birding, reached only by charter or specialist tour with basic guest houses.
objection: For: a significant wilderness named by a guide. Against: very remote, operator-only, one source.

name: Bulldog Track
reason: One counted source (tourism board Gulf page, calls it a must-see): a 60 km trek from the Lakekamu side to Wau; an expedition, and half lies in Morobe.
objection: For: a named multi-day trek, 1,226 views. Against: one source, specialist, ends outside the region.
